baseline_models.focus_anchor: The genitive construction kitaba al-fujjar and emphatic la-fi sijjin link a class-defined record to containment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A composed written dossier gathers the restraint-breaches of a named class and is held in a detention-domain. The record and its owners are linked metonymically, while the focus alone leaves open whether Sijjin is a place, a state, or the repository itself.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies a composed dossier rather than an unstructured moral label.
Departure from right and breach of restraint supply the conduct that defines the dossier's owners.
Confinement in detention gives la-fi a concrete custodial force.

changed_reading.before: A generic book belonging to wicked people is in an ominous place.
changed_reading.after: A composed dossier of boundary-breach is placed under custody, with the record already beginning to stand for the people it records.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kitab can name not only writing but an effective decree or enrollment, while sijjin can name severity that fixes its object in place.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can function as a classificatory act: a binding inscription enrolls the fujjar as a group and fixes their status. On this reading, the book does not merely describe a prior condition; it performs or certifies placement.

activation_trace.role: Inscription as binding judgment makes the document effective rather than merely archival.
Enrollment in a register supplies the mechanism by which a named class receives an official status.
Breach of restraint is the criterion of enrollment, not an independent context theme.
Severity that pins down supplies the irreversible force of the registered judgment.

changed_reading.before: The book reports where the wicked already are.
changed_reading.after: The kitab is also a binding enrollment that places and pins the boundary-breakers within a determinate status.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three focus roots form opposed motions: K-T-B joins, F-J-R splits and pours out, and S-J-N encloses and fixes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah compresses an outward-breaking mode into a joined and confined object. What repeatedly breaches limits is not left diffuse: its acts are assembled into one record and its expansive motion is countered by custody.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another turns dispersed acts into a single compiled object.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the outward vector that the compilation captures.
Detention supplies the opposing enclosure around what would otherwise disperse.
Pinning severity converts enclosure from passive storage into arrested motion.

changed_reading.before: Fujjar is only an ethical label and Sijjin only its destination.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a counterforce: outward breach is gathered into a dossier and arrested inside a fixing enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early measuring sequence turns the focus kitab into a directional transaction ledger. It preserves who demanded completion and who delivered deficiency; Sijjin then functions as custody that prevents the asymmetry from being diluted, reversed, or made to disappear.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies the ledger in which opposed sides of an exchange remain legible.
Breach of restraint makes transactional asymmetry a concrete instance of the focus class.
Pinning severity makes the recorded discrepancy resistant to evasion.
Measuring food supplies the incoming side of the ledger and its expected quantity.
The repeated measuring branch supplies the outgoing side, making direction rather than commodity decisive.
Completion without deficiency establishes the full amount demanded for oneself.
The scale of justice supplies the norm against which the two directions can be compared.
Shorting measure and weight supplies the exact recorded violation rather than generic loss.

structural_cues: The branchless T-F-F cue at 83:1 is used only to structurally name the agents of the paired transactions.
The parallel idha clauses repeat measuring while reversing who receives, exposing a beneficiary-sensitive rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full taking, short giving, repeated measure, and a just scale; the reader adds the arrow that kitab preserves the directional mismatch and Sijjin locks it against revision. A live alternative is that the transactions merely exemplify wickedness without shaping the document's function.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a general moral record of wicked people.
changed_reading.after: The focus contains an audit-grade counter-ledger that retains the exact asymmetry between claims made on others and value returned to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection and universal standing convert Sijjin from an undated prison into pre-hearing custody and convert kitab from storage into a docket. The document fixes a case that will be raised and stood before sovereign judgment.

activation_trace.role: Binding judgment supplies the docket's adjudicative force.
Detention supplies custody pending the context's mass standing.
Certainty after an indication frames the coming record and hearing as what should already be inferable.
Stirring the still from rest supplies the transition from custody to appearance.
The day's severe event supplies a determinate horizon for the held docket.
Resurrection and standing of the Hour supply the hearing-like assembly.
Sovereignty and mastery identify the authority before whom the docket stands.

structural_cues: The question at 83:4 is expanded by the temporal phrases at 83:5-6 before the focus declaration.
All people stand, so the focus record is embedded in a public hearing rather than private storage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival, a severe day, universal standing, and sovereignty; the reader adds the procedural arrow from confinement to custody pending adjudication. A live alternative is that Sijjin denotes only a final destination and has no provisional docket function.

changed_reading.before: The book is archived in a timeless punitive place.
changed_reading.after: The book is a binding case file held for the day when its owners are raised and made to stand before the judging authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question about Sijjin followed by a marked book permits an appositional reading: the container and contained document partially collapse. Sijjin is not only where the record lies; the fixed, marked register can itself be the mode by which deeds and status are confined.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies the object whose relation to Sijjin is being reclassified.
Confinement supplies the carceral quality that can migrate from a place to the register itself.
Knowledge and discernment mark the following phrase as an unveiling of what Sijjin is.
The repeated confinement term becomes the direct object of the defining question.
The immediately following written book supplies the candidate answer to the question.
A marked line in a book or register makes the answer fixed, indexed, and document-like.

structural_cues: 83:8 asks ma sijjin, and 83:9 follows with the verbless phrase kitab marqum.
The same K-T-B and S-J-N roots recur immediately after the focus, tightening rather than broadening reference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a defining question followed by a marked book; the reader adds the appositional arrow that the answer identifies Sijjin with, or through, the register. A live alternative is strict containment: 83:9 describes only the book located inside an independent place.

changed_reading.before: A book is placed inside a separate prison-like location called Sijjin.
changed_reading.after: Sijjin and the marked register overlap: fixed inscription is itself a carceral technology that holds deeds, classification, and owners together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context sets two textual operations against each other: signs are recited in sequence, then verbally downgraded to false old lines, while the focus record is followed by an actually marked register. The book therefore becomes authenticated counter-script that survives the owners' attempt to relabel authoritative signs.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch anchors the model in the focus's durable documentary medium.
Breach of restraint includes the epistemic breach enacted by rejecting the signs.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies the attempted deauthorization of the recited material.
Accounting and recompense identify what the denied discourse concerns and what the record will settle.
Following in sequence supplies ordered recitation, a live counterpart to joined written lines.
The visible-sign branch supplies evidence that is being rhetorically misclassified.
A ranked written line creates a direct documentary echo with the focus kitab.
The false-tales branch supplies the dismissive label imposed on those lines by the speaker.

structural_cues: K-DH-B recurs across 83:10-12 and 83:17, surrounding the quoted dismissal at 83:13.
The marked book at 83:9 precedes a speech act that tries to demote recited signs to inherited stories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered recitation, visible signs, denial, written lines, and the label of false tales; the reader adds the arrow that the marked focus record answers this deauthorization as authenticated counter-script. A live alternative is that the two writing images are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: The focus book silently stores bad deeds.
changed_reading.after: The focus book also defeats a battle over textual authority: those who relabel signs cannot relabel away their own fixed register.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acquisition becomes a deposited layer on the heart, and the no-exit branch of R-Y-N makes that layer internally carceral. The external compiled book and the internal coating become two scales of the same process: acts are joined into a record and simultaneously build the condition that confines perception.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the accretive compilation of repeated acquisitions.
Repeated breaches supply the material that accumulates rather than a free-standing heart theme.
Severity that pins down gives the accumulated layer its carceral effect.
A condition with no exit supplies the internal analogue to Sijjin.
The heart supplies the surface on which the acquired layer becomes an inward enclosure.
Seeking and acquiring supplies the repeated input that deposits the layer.

structural_cues: Kalla bal at 83:14 corrects the preceding verbal excuse by exposing a produced condition.
The clause ma kanu yaksibun attributes the coating to iterated acquisition rather than an imposed accident.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a no-exit coating on hearts caused by acquisition; the reader adds the arrow that each acquisition deposits material in both dossier and heart, making Sijjin external and internal at once. A live alternative is that heart-coating concerns perception only and does not describe how the focus book is formed.

changed_reading.before: Sijjin is wholly external custody imposed after deeds are recorded.
changed_reading.after: The owners progressively build a Sijjin-like interior while their same acquisitions are joined into the external record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confinement image expands from spatial detention into access control. Enrollment in the focus register fixes a relation of exclusion from the sovereign, after which contact with fiercely burning fire gives the exclusion an embodied destination.

activation_trace.role: Register enrollment supplies the status that governs access.
Confinement supplies the bounded side from which access is denied.
Sovereignty identifies the person from whom the registered group is excluded.
Prevention of arrival turns prison-space into a relational barrier.
A screening barrier gives material form to the denied relation.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the next embodied phase after exclusion.
Fierce burning supplies the destination's active severity rather than mere empty distance.

structural_cues: The preposition an in 83:15 expresses relational separation, not simply enclosure within walls.
Thumma in 83:16 sequences blocked access before contact with the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barrier from the sovereign followed by fiery contact; the reader adds the metonymic arrow from the record's confinement to the owners' access status. A live alternative is that veiling and fire are separate consequences with no register-mediated relation.

changed_reading.before: Sijjin confines a document in a place.
changed_reading.after: The registered placement also encodes an access regime: its owners are fixed on the barred side of relation before entering the fiery consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-verbatim construction creates a two-register architecture. Both groups have a marked kitab, but their records are enrolled into opposed domains: the focus's fixing confinement and the counterpart's elevation, presence, and privileged witnessing.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment supplies the focus side of a paired classificatory system.
Boundary-breach supplies one class criterion within the paired system.
Pinning severity supplies the lower register's fixing pole.
The repeated enrollment branch supplies a formally matched counterpart to the focus register.
Truthfulness carried through speech and action supplies the opposed class criterion.
Elevation supplies the vertical counter-pole to fixing confinement.
The same marked-register branch establishes documentary equivalence across the two poles.
Presence with witnessing supplies an access relation around the elevated record.
Privileged nearness supplies the social and spatial status of those witnessing that register.

structural_cues: 83:18 repeats the focus's kalla inna kitaba X la-fi Y frame with the opposed group and domain.
Both domains receive a ma adraka question and a marked-book answer, while 83:21 adds explicit witnessing to the elevated side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored syntax, opposed class roots, marked books, elevation, and privileged witnessing; the reader adds the architectural arrow that these are coordinated registries rather than unrelated locations. A live alternative is that each proper term simply names a place containing an otherwise identical record.

changed_reading.before: The focus book is an isolated record in an isolated prison.
changed_reading.after: It is the fixing pole of a paired registry system that sorts groups into opposed vertical and access statuses while preserving parallel documentary form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sealed drink sequence back-activates Sijjin as secure custody, not punishment alone. A seal prevents access, its impression authenticates, holding keeps contents in place, and prior mixing makes preservation of a determinate composition meaningful; by material analogy the marked book is a tamper-resistant archive.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies the document whose integrity the seal analogy changes.
Confinement supplies secure custody as a live secondary function of the focus location.
A preventing, secured seal supplies tamper resistance and controlled access.
The seal's stamped impression supplies authentication analogous to the register's marking.
The remote holding branch cross-activates containment while the local surface remains the fragrant substance.
The musk branch preserves the local fragrance sense and prevents the holding echo from replacing it.
Mixing supplies a composed content whose fixed recipe can be preserved by sealing.

structural_cues: The seal root repeats in 83:25-26 before the text identifies a mixture in 83:27.
The later sealed vessel belongs to the opposed register's reward, so any transfer to Sijjin is analogical rather than direct predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sealing, stamped effect, holding, fragrance, and mixture; the reader adds the cross-domain arrow from preserved drink to preserved record. A live alternative is that sealing belongs exclusively to reward imagery and contributes nothing to the focus archive.

changed_reading.before: Confinement only punishes by enclosing the book.
changed_reading.after: Confinement can also preserve evidentiary integrity: the marked dossier is held like authenticated contents under a secured seal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social sequence distinguishes witnessing from unauthorized surveillance. Offenders look, label others lost, and behave as judges, but they were not sent as guardians; the marked kitab becomes the legitimate preserving witness that reverses who classifies whom, and recompense returns the judgment to its actors.

activation_trace.role: Official enrollment anchors the correction of informal social labels in the focus.
Detention supplies the final reversal of the self-appointed classifiers' position.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the context's positive model of authorized testimony.
Crime and offense identify the observers whose social judgment will be corrected.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the gaze from which the false classification is asserted.
Deviation from guidance supplies the label that the observers impose on the other group.
Guarding and watching supply the office explicitly denied to those observers.
Recompense returning to the worker supplies the final reversal of classifier and classified.

structural_cues: The branchless GH-M-Z cue at 83:30 is retained only as a structural gesture within the escalating social surveillance sequence.
Laughter and looking reverse between 83:29 and 83:34-35, while 83:33 denies the mockers any guardian commission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized witnessing for a register, criminal observers, false classification, denied guardianship, and returning recompense; the reader adds the arrow that the focus book is the valid counter-witness to their gaze. A live alternative is that the book records deeds but has no special relation to social misclassification.

changed_reading.before: The focus book is a private archive of wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The focus book is also a corrective public witness that invalidates unauthorized social judgment and reverses the position of those who watched and labeled others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accounting branch of D-Y-N and the final return-of-recompense branch turn the focus kitab from inert storage into a settlement circuit. Actions are joined and fixed, then their consequence returns to the actor; Sijjin prevents the causal account from leaking before settlement.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the linkage of many actions into one settled account.
Binding judgment turns the joined account into an effective consequence.
Pinning severity holds the causal account stable until it returns.
Accounting and recompense supply the settlement domain denied by the focus group.
A consequence returning to its worker supplies the account's output direction.
The production of an act supplies the input that returns as recompense.

structural_cues: The final rhetorical question directly couples recompense with ma kanu yafalun.
The surah moves from asymmetric commercial settlement near the opening to returned settlement at the close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, produced acts, and recompense returning to the producer; the reader adds the causal arrow that kitab mediates this return by joining and fixing the account. A live alternative is that the book is evidentiary only and the return occurs independently.

changed_reading.before: The focus record passively preserves a past inventory.
changed_reading.after: The focus record is a closed settlement circuit in which produced acts remain fixed until their consequence returns to the producer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the manumission-contract branch of K-T-B is technically specialized and is not the focus noun's default sense. It remains anchored in kitab and gains a visible inversion from the co-present confinement branch: a documentary medium that can structure release instead fixes the breakers in non-release. Downstream prose should call this a legal-material reversal, never a claim that the verse literally names a manumission contract.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins kitab to a detention-domain, allowing a release-document branch to be carried as an inverted possibility.

activation_trace.role: A contract whose performance ends bondage supplies the legal mechanism being reversed.
Breach of restraint supplies the conduct by which the would-be release document becomes self-binding.
Confinement supplies the inverted outcome of the documentary contract.

changed_reading.before: Kitab is simply an incriminating record.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is an anti-release document: the owners' performed terms bind them into confinement instead of completing emancipation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the S-J-N branch about splitting a palm trunk into two strips is specialized and distant from detention. It remains anchored through the focus's joining, splitting, and Sijjin roots, and the later mirrored upper register supplies an actual binary architecture. Downstream prose should present partitioning only as a material analogy for sorting, not as a lexical translation of Sijjin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: K-T-B joins, F-J-R splits, and the remote S-J-N partition branch sits in the same focus clause; 83:18 then repeats the clause for the opposite register.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the single compiled stock that can subsequently be sorted.
Wide splitting supplies a focus-internal partition vector.
Splitting a trunk into two strips supplies the odd but concrete sorting operation.
The repeated joined record supplies the second member of the context's two-way division.
Elevation supplies the opposed strip or pole against the focus's fixing confinement.

changed_reading.before: Sijjin is only one destination for an already sorted record.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Sijjin participates in the sorting operation itself: the compiled human account is partitioned into opposed fixed and elevated registers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because overflowing generosity is antithetical to the ordinary local force of fujjar. It remains anchored as a reversal activated by full intake, deficient outflow, the F-J-R flow branch, and final confinement. Downstream prose should describe a failed or privatized flow of generosity, not replace the ethical noun with 'generous people.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus F-J-R root can image both outflow and expansive generosity, while the immediate context makes flow radically directional.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing generosity supplies the positive flow whose direction is perversely reversed.
Wide outflow supplies the hydraulic mechanism shared by giving and breach.
Confinement supplies the terminal stoppage of the privatized flow.
Full receipt supplies abundance flowing toward the self.
Deficient measure supplies the blocked outward flow toward others.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the fujjar are failed channels of abundance: they draw fullness inward, throttle outward flow, and are finally themselves stopped.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because dawn is a remote F-J-R branch and the local plural is governed much more directly by breach of restraint. It remains anchored through that focus root, the packet's true/false dawn scope, a later N-F-S dawn-opening branch, and the repeated visible brightness of laughter that reverses owners. Downstream prose should call this a false-dawn resonance or temporal flash, never a primary lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus F-J-R root carries a dawn-breaking branch with a true/false distinction, while the later social sequence displays and reverses apparent brightness.

activation_trace.role: Dawn breaking from night, including true and false dawn, supplies the counterfeit-brightness possibility.
Pinning severity supplies the arrest of what looked like an advancing dawn.
The opening of dawn through a breath-like image reactivates the focus's dawn branch at a distance.
A visible gleam like laughter supplies the first group's apparent social brightness.
The repeated gleam under reversed ownership exposes the earlier brightness as temporary and false.

changed_reading.before: The fujjar possess a stable social ascendancy before later punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their visible ascendancy is a false dawn: a brief gleam that does not mature and is arrested when the laughter changes owners.

strongest_changes: The measuring context turns a generic moral book into a directional ledger that preserves full intake against deficient outflow.
The question-answer sequence at 83:8-9 partially identifies Sijjin with the marked register, making inscription itself carceral.
The heart-coating sequence makes confinement both external archive and internally accumulated condition.
The mirrored record at 83:18-21 places the focus inside a paired vertical registry architecture rather than an isolated prison image.
The closing return of recompense makes the record a settlement circuit, not inert storage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots generate unusually coherent opposed mechanics: joining, outward breach, and fixing enclosure. Context then changes those mechanics through commerce, hearing, textual contest, accretion, access control, mirrored registers, sealing, social surveillance, and reversal without forcing them into one final interpretation. Remote branches remain live only where they produce inspectable transformations, especially anti-manumission, binary partition, asymmetric overflow, and false-dawn brightness.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 83:9 identifies Sijjin with the marked book or only describes what is contained there remains grammatically live.
The movement from custody of the record to custody or exclusion of its owners depends on explicit metonymy supplied by the reader.
The paired-register model strongly supports coordinated classification but does not by itself decide whether the named domains are places, statuses, documents, or layered combinations.
The seal, manumission, palm-partition, generosity, and dawn models are branch-valid analogies whose distance requires downstream qualification.
